messages: Maria (Design): Quick check — I'm iterating on the retention panel presets. Two UX goals: make defaults clearer for SMB customers, and ensure screen reader context for default vs custom. Sketch attached (not included). Alex P: Can you paste the exact copy you want for the presets? I worry 'Standard'/'Strict' are ambiguous. Maria (Design): Thinking: "30 days (Default)", "6 months", "Custom range". Tooltip: "Default applies company-wide unless overridden." Short and scannable. Eva - PM: +1. Also we need the KMS badge nearby. How will that read to assistive tech? Right now it's just an icon. kate-accessibility: Icon-only is problematic. Add visually-hidden text: Key management: Customer-managed KMS. Also aria-describedby linking to tooltip id. Jamie - Eng: Implementable. Proposal: Luis - QA: Also test keyboard focus order: presets -> retention slider -> kms button -> save. Current order jumps the other way. Maria (Design): Good catch. Let's ensure the toolbar is after the slider in DOM so tab order matches visual flow. Alex P: Copy nit: instead of "Default applies company-wide unless overridden" maybe "This default retention applies to new data unless a route override is set." More precise. Eva - PM: Shorter better for mobile. How about "Applies to new records unless overridden". Maria (Design): I like Eva's. Update copy: "Applies to new records unless overridden by policy." kate-accessibility: Also add role="status" aria-live="polite" for the preset confirmation toast when someone changes default. SR users should hear confirmation. Jamie - Eng: Will add aria-live on the toast. One question: do we announce the exact retention value or just "Retention updated"? kate-accessibility: Announce full: "Default retention updated to 30 days" helps screen reader context. Luis - QA: Audit log copy: current event says "retention changed" with no actor. We need "Default retention changed to 30 days by Eva" and include KMS change events like "KMS set to customer-managed". Eva - PM: Good point. Add actor and timestamp format consistent with audit (ISO). We also need an offline-friendly short code for Japanese/localization team. Maria (Design): On color — the 'Default' pill uses teal on white; contrast at 3.2:1. Can we darken to meet 4.5:1? Maybe #0B6E59 instead of #1ABC9C. Alex P: I'll run a quick contrast tool and push a PR. Also will ensure focus ring meets 3px thickness in our theme. Maria (Design): Last: keyboard label for slider: aria-label="Retention length in days" and add aria-valuetext like "30 days". Jamie - Eng: Got it. I'll draft a PR and ping this thread when ready. deploy-bot: Reminder: staging build succeeded for branch retention-presets. Deploy URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/build/retention-presets Maria (Design): Thanks! Please include screenshots in PR and tag kate-accessibility for review. Eva - PM: Thanks team, will file a follow-up ticket for localized strings.
